provenance.process: Scene-specific art direction, visual inspection, one targeted correction, and ImageMagick sRGB WebP conversion
provenance.disclosure: These are original project images made with generative assistance. Museum objects and Homeric sources informed the research and art direction but their pixels were not embedded.

assets.storyBeat: Odysseus hesitates beside his ship while Troy burns behind the departing crew.
assets.artDirection: Photographed practical-set logic, human-scale blocking, wet hand-hewn materials, subdued 35mm texture, and a dark text-safe field on the left.
assets.historicalBoundary: An original modern reconstruction informed by Homeric narrative and Late Bronze Age material research; not a film frame or archaeological document.

assets.storyBeat: Odysseus guards the Book 11 blood offering while his mother and other shades gather at a distance.
assets.artDirection: A damp sea-cave set, human-scale gauze-like shades, tactile ritual offerings, cold natural light, and restrained film grain without Christian-hell spectacle.
assets.historicalBoundary: An original modern composition built from Homeric ritual cues; it does not claim a canonical ancient image of the Underworld.

assets.storyBeat: The old dog Argos recognizes the disguised Odysseus at the threshold of his Ithacan house.
assets.artDirection: A lived-in household set where Argos and Odysseus form the first read; the bow, axe heads, loom, and owl remain quiet second-read evidence.
assets.historicalBoundary: An original modern composition informed by Homeric recognition scenes and later visual reception; no production design or actor likeness is copied.
